The other two face him and then turn to look in the direction he points. The film then shows all three from behind, with their neckerchiefs and 295 patch visible, staring out at the passing crowd as if searching.

The narration immediately after the ice-cream cue states the editorial point explicitly. At about 8 minutes 33 seconds it says, So they lost the troop.

In other words, stopping for Eskimo Pies caused the three to lose the main body of Troop 295. Their animated discussion, pointing, and searching gaze are the visual behavior of boys who have just realized they are lost.

Therefore the most likely subject of their conversation is being lost: where the rest of Troop 295 went, which way to look, and what to do to rejoin the troop.
